name: Tsukumi Sango
source: She came to the island together with her friend [url=/c14226]Konami[/url] during the summer vacation to work for cold hard cash. A cheerful girl, she looks at everything positively and is a mood maker. Because everyone around her is older, she planned to use honorifics but failed massively. She has a very straightforward personality and can speak with [url=/c14224]Soutarou[/url] normally, and she also lovingly refers to [url=/c14219]Umi[/url] as "Umi-oneechan". She is very good friends with Konami and is always worried about her, but at the same time she works really hard.
